about: What a vendor pays for one of each, in copper (100 copper = 1 silver, 100 silver = 1 gold) - the 'Sell Price' line of the game's own tooltip, read off Zel's screenshots on 2026-11-25. A price can also be written like "19s" or "2s 40c". This list is only a starting point: wow.py counts ANY item the chat says was looted, and adds new ones (price unknown) to recordings/wow/fish_prices.json on this PC, where prices typed into wow_gui.py are kept too. That file wins over this one.
